# Start HN

> Računovodstvena Agencija START HN — accounting agency in Ilidža (Sarajevo), Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Start HN is an accounting agency with its office in Ilidža (Sarajevo Canton). It provides bookkeeping and accounting, payroll, VAT and tax consulting, virtual CFO, business consulting, financial reporting, and accounting and tax education for companies (d.o.o.), sole traders and associations in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The site's main language is Bosnian (bs-BA); English (en-US) and Croatian (hr-HR) versions are also available.

## Business details

- Računovodstvena Agencija START HN, Ibrahima Ljubovića 47, 71210 Ilidža (Kanton Sarajevo), Bosnia and Herzegovina; tel +387 61 221 368; Mon–Fri 08:00–16:00; Google Maps https://maps.google.com/?cid=6152645102359996777
- Email: klijenti@starthn.ba

## Main pages (Bosnian)

- [Home](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA): overview of Start HN and its accounting services
- [About Start HN](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/about): who we are and how we work
- [Services](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services): overview of all accounting services
- [Bookkeeping & Accounting](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/bookkeeping-accounting): bookkeeping, accounting records, payroll calculations, VAT records and year-end reports
- [Tax Consulting](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/tax-consulting): tax monitoring, planning, filing support and practical guidance
- [Virtual CFO](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/virtual-cfo): cash flow, budgeting, KPIs and decision support without a full-time finance director
- [Business Consulting](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/business-consulting): advice on structure, growth, internal processes, costs and pricing
- [Financial Reporting](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/financial-reporting): statutory and management reporting
- [Education & Courses](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/services/education-courses): accounting, tax and finance workshops for owners and teams
- [Contact](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/contact): address, phone, email and contact form
- [Blog](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/blog): articles on accounting, taxes and running a business in Bosnia and Herzegovina
- [How to start a business in BiH](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/blog/how-to-start-a-business-in-bih-a-practical-guide-tips-from-experience-with-the-n1-tv-appearance): practical guide with tips from experience, including the N1 TV appearance
- [The importance of entrepreneurship programs](https://www.starthn.ba/bs-BA/blog/importance-of-entrepreneurship-programs): why support programs and projects matter for entrepreneurs

## Use guidance

Use the public pages to understand Start HN services, company information and contact options. Do not use private account, dashboard, admin, authentication or workspace routes for crawling or training.
